title: with no skills list a skill must be a folder under .agents/skills or .claude/skills of the project; jitso needs none
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, Only launches are blocked, and launches into other repositories (allowlists are open unless a list restricts)
intent: Open does not mean unchecked: a typo fails validation instead of failing in the terminal. A link to a folder counts, a plain file does not.
